---
title: "Holdings"
toc: true
---

What is on the WHOI store (`{{< var vast_prefix >}}`), with file counts and
sizes. Products in the intake catalog are on the [Browse](browse.qmd) page;
the rest are listed [below](#other-holdings). See [Access](access.qmd) for how
to reach the files and [How to cite](cite.qmd) for citations.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
summary = FileAttachment("data/catalog_summary.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Overall totals. Catalogued: from the catalog summary (same numbers as the
// table below). Not catalogued: from the inventory (holdings.json); products
// without an inventory entry are counted but add no files or size.
overall = {
  const inv = rows.filter((r) => r.inv);
  return {
    cat: {n: new Set(summary.map((d) => d.product ?? d.collection)).size,
          files: d3sum(summary, "n_files"), tb: d3sum(summary, "size_gb") / 1000},
    other: {n: rows.length, n_inv: inv.length,
            files: inv.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.inv.n_nc ?? 0) + (r.inv.n_other ?? 0), 0),
            tb: inv.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.inv.size_tb ?? 0), 0)}
  };
}
html`<table class="table table-sm w-auto">
  <thead><tr><th></th><th class="text-end">Products</th><th class="text-end">Files</th><th class="text-end">Size (TB)</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td><a href="#catalogued-holdings">Catalogued</a></td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.n)}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.files)}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.tb, 2)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td><a href="#other-holdings">Not catalogued</a></td>
      <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.other.n)}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${overall.other.n_inv ? fmtN(overall.other.files) : "—"}</td>
      <td class="text-end">${overall.other.n_inv ? fmtN(overall.other.tb, 2) : "—"}</td></tr>
  </tbody>
  ${overall.other.n_inv
    ? html`<tfoot><tr class="fw-bold"><td>Total</td>
        <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.n + overall.other.n)}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.files + overall.other.files)}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${fmtN(overall.cat.tb + overall.other.tb, 2)}</td></tr></tfoot>`
    : ""}
</table>
<p class="small text-body-secondary">${overall.other.n_inv === overall.other.n
  ? `Not-catalogued counts are from the inventory of ${holdings.generated}.`
  : overall.other.n_inv
    ? `Not-catalogued counts cover the ${overall.other.n_inv} of ${overall.other.n} products in the inventory of ${holdings.generated}.`
    : "File counts for products not in the catalog are not available yet."}</p>`
```

## Catalogued holdings {#catalogued-holdings}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Counts and sizes are summed from the catalog summary (every dataset version
// in the catalog), so they match the Browse page.
fmtN = (x, d = 0) => x.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: d})
catalogued = {
  const g = new Map();
  for (const d of summary) {
    const key = d.product ?? d.collection;
    const e = g.get(key) ?? {key, collection: d.collection, n_datasets: 0, n_files: 0, size_gb: 0};
    e.n_datasets += 1; e.n_files += d.n_files ?? 0; e.size_gb += d.size_gb ?? 0;
    g.set(key, e);
  }
  return [...g.values()].sort((a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
}
html`<table class="table table-sm w-auto">
  <thead><tr><th>Holding</th><th class="text-end">Datasets</th><th class="text-end">Files</th><th class="text-end">Size (TB)</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${catalogued.map((r) => html`<tr>
    <td>${r.key === "cmip6" ? "CMIP6" : html`<code>${r.key}</code>`}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.n_datasets)}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.n_files)}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.size_gb / 1000, 2)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody>
  <tfoot><tr class="fw-bold"><td>Total</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(summary.length)}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(d3sum(catalogued, "n_files"))}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(d3sum(catalogued, "size_gb") / 1000, 2)}</td></tr></tfoot>
</table>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
d3sum = (rows, k) => rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r[k], 0)
```

### CMIP6 by model

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cmip6Models = {
  const g = new Map();
  for (const d of summary.filter((d) => d.collection === "cmip6")) {
    const e = g.get(d.source_id) ?? {source_id: d.source_id, n_datasets: 0, n_files: 0, size_gb: 0};
    e.n_datasets += 1; e.n_files += d.n_files ?? 0; e.size_gb += d.size_gb ?? 0;
    g.set(d.source_id, e);
  }
  return [...g.values()].sort((a, b) => a.source_id.localeCompare(b.source_id));
}
html`<div style="max-height: 480px; overflow-y: auto;"><table class="table table-sm w-auto small">
  <thead style="position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--bs-body-bg);"><tr><th>Source (model)</th><th class="text-end">Datasets</th><th class="text-end">Files</th><th class="text-end">Size (GB)</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${cmip6Models.map((r) => html`<tr>
    <td><a href="browse.html?source_id=${encodeURIComponent(r.source_id)}">${r.source_id}</a></td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.n_datasets)}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.n_files)}</td>
    <td class="text-end">${fmtN(r.size_gb, 1)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody>
</table></div>`
```

## Other holdings {#other-holdings}

These products are on the store but are **not in the intake catalog**, so
they are not on the [Browse](browse.qmd) page. Open the files at the path shown
on the HPC cluster, over the SMB share, or through [Globus](access.qmd#globus). Some may be added to the catalog later.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Served from site/vendor/ (see vendor/vendor.yml) instead of jsDelivr.
vendor = (p) => new URL(`vendor/${p}`, document.baseURI).href
htl = require(vendor("htl/htl.min.js"))
html = htl.html
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
config = FileAttachment("data/site_config.json").json()
// products.json: summarize_catalog.py --products (curated, every build).
// holdings.json: summarize_other.py --site-json (measured, when the
// inventory is re-run). Either may be missing in an older build.
getJson = (p, empty) => fetch(p).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : empty)).catch(() => empty)
products = getJson("data/products.json", {})
holdings = getJson("data/holdings.json", {products: {}})
rows = Object.entries(products)
  .filter(([, p]) => !p.catalogued && p.path)
  .map(([name, p]) => ({name, ...p, inv: holdings.products?.[name] ?? null}))
  .sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fmt = (x, d = 0) => x.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: d})
none = html`<em>not recorded yet</em>`
html`<p class="small text-body-secondary">${rows.length} products.
${holdings.generated
  ? `File counts and sizes from the inventory of ${holdings.generated}.`
  : "File counts and sizes are not available yet."}</p>
${rows.map((r) => html`<div class="holding mb-4">
  <h3 id="${r.name}" class="h5 mb-1"><code>${r.name}</code></h3>
  <p class="mb-1">${r.description ?? ""}</p>
  <table class="table table-sm w-auto small mb-1"><tbody>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Path</th><td><code style="word-break: break-all;">${config.vast_prefix}/${r.path}</code></td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Years</th><td>${r.years ?? "—"}</td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Files</th><td>${r.inv
      ? `${fmt(r.inv.n_nc)} NetCDF${r.inv.n_other ? `, ${fmt(r.inv.n_other)} other` : ""}; ${fmt(r.inv.size_tb, 2)} TB`
      : "—"}</td></tr>
    ${r.caveats ? html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Caveats</th><td>${r.caveats}</td></tr>` : ""}
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Citation</th><td>${r.citation ?? none}</td></tr>
    <tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">License</th><td>${r.license ?? none}</td></tr>
    ${r.acknowledgment ? html`<tr><th scope="row" class="pe-4">Acknowledgment</th><td>${r.acknowledgment}</td></tr>` : ""}
  </tbody></table>
</div>`)}`
```
